title: Rename to Study Vibe, add Hindi translations, and add illustrative subject images

requirements.text: Rename the app/site branding from “Study Vibes Class 9” to “Study Vibe” across all user-visible UI and page metadata (including the header title in the React UI and the HTML document title).
acceptanceCriteria: Header branding text displays “Study Vibe” instead of “Study Vibes Class 9”.
The browser tab/title (frontend/index.html) is updated to “Study Vibe”.
Any remaining visible occurrences of “Study Vibes Class 9” in the UI are updated to “Study Vibe” (excluding image filenames unless explicitly changed).

requirements.text: Add Hindi translations for all subject titles and subject summary content, and provide a UI control to switch the displayed language between English and Hindi for the entire page (navigation labels, subject card titles, and subject content).
acceptanceCriteria: A language toggle is available in the UI (e.g., in the header) with English and Hindi options.
When Hindi is selected, each subject card shows Hindi title and Hindi content for the same subject, and the quick-jump navigation labels reflect the selected language.
When English is selected, the current English titles/content remain available exactly as before.
No subject is missing a Hindi translation (titles and content) for: Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Hindi, Sanskrit, Computer Application, English.

requirements.text: Add a subject-specific illustrative image for each subject (Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Hindi, Sanskrit, Computer Application, English) and display it in the UI within each subject card in a consistent, responsive layout.

quotes: Add illustrative images of all the subjects

acceptanceCriteria: Each subject card displays its own illustrative image loaded from static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
There are 7 distinct subject images (one per subject), and they visually differ to match the subject theme.
Images are sized/cropped consistently across cards and do not break the grid layout on mobile/tablet/desktop.
Images include appropriate alt text that follows the selected language (English alt text in English mode; Hindi alt text in Hindi mode).

requirements.text: Update existing generated branding images to align with the renamed app “Study Vibe”, and ensure the UI continues to reference the correct static asset filenames under /assets/generated/.
acceptanceCriteria: The logo and hero/banner visuals are updated to match the “Study Vibe” branding (while keeping the app’s warm academic theme).
frontend/src/App.tsx continues to load the logo and hero images from /assets/generated/ and they render correctly in header/hero.
No broken image links are present in the header or hero sections.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook files under frontend/src/hooks/* listed as immutable in system context.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor; no new backend work is required for this static-content change unless strictly necessary.
nonGoals: Adding new backend APIs or persistence for translations/images.
Adding login/logout UI or making app features depend on Internet Identity.
Adding new subjects beyond the existing seven Class 9 subjects.

required: Mathematics illustrative icon/mini-illustration, flat warm academic style (subject-mathematics.dim_768x512.png)
Science illustrative icon/mini-illustration, flat warm academic style (subject-science.dim_768x512.png)

preferencesToAdd: Prefer bilingual (English/Hindi) content with a simple in-app language toggle.
